marker.step_source:
import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

Implemented worker/UI isolation for Agents-tab row graphs on source revision `e0f1a8d43` (the same tree the plan diagnosed). Cached `Agent` objects are no longer shared across the worker/UI boundary.

**What changed.** `_make_prepared_apply_snapshot` still does a cheap list capture for stale-token checks. Before any mutating prepare (incomplete merge, status overrides, `sort_and_reorder`, slot annotation, proc-shell carryover), `own_prepared_apply_snapshot` copies the reachable row graph with a shared memo. Incoming loader rows stay worker-owned; live cached rows are replaced by copies. `frozen=True` on the snapshot dataclass is documented as not isolating the mutable rows it holds.

**Race coverage.** A clan in `@epic` with Claude + Codex members, and a multi-provider family, keep their provider order, child links, family classification, status, and counts while relationship normalization is paused, after the worker finishes, and if the worker raises or is abandoned. Ten unrelated exact-delta prepares leave the live prefix unchanged. Legitimate additions, deletions, and dismissals still appear on apply.

**Cost.** On an 80-row graph with shared family back-pointers: one copy of 80 unique objects in **14.2 ms** on the worker thread; a repeated 3-row copy against the same memo was **0.003 ms**. Copying stays off the event loop on async refreshes.

**Checks.** Lint (`just check` gates through symvision/toobig) passed. Focused isolation, merge, apply-boundary, fold, and BY_STATUS panel tests passed. The scoped `just check` lane escalated to the full suite: **4505 passed**. The **3 failures** are unrelated `sase_core_rs` binding `select_remaining_commit_obligations` (installed wheel vs unpublished core capability); they are not in this change.

**Live TUI limit.** This was a disposable workspace clone, not the user’s live session. Proof is controlled replay (thread barriers + ten prepares + BY_STATUS panel identity), not a live athena soak.
